categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the tire manufacturing industry, producing various types of tires including energy-saving eco-friendly tires, commercial vehicle snow tires, asymmetric pattern car tires, and high-performance sports tires. Additionally, it generates rental income from real estate holdings, accounting for a smaller portion of revenue.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on developing environmentally friendly tire formulations, high-performance tire series, racing tires, and asymmetric tread patterns. Production involves outsourcing to overseas and domestic contract manufacturers, with strict quality control and proprietary design specifications to maintain product standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include new vehicle manufacturers and distributors across global markets such as the United States, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, CIS countries, and Africa. The company serves automotive sectors requiring passenger car, commercial vehicle, and specialty tires.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with sales and distribution networks spanning the Americas, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and other international regions. Manufacturing is outsourced to contract factories in Vietnam, Thailand, China, and Taiwan to navigate trade barriers and optimize supply.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company functions primarily in the midstream segment of the tire supply chain, focusing on tire design, development, and brand management while outsourcing manufacturing to third-party contract factories. It sources raw materials such as natural and synthetic rubber, carbon black, and steel wire from upstream suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding overseas contract manufacturing to mitigate anti-dumping tariffs, diversifying revenue through licensing, royalties, and technical services, and enhancing product innovation in eco-friendly and high-performance tires. The company invests in R&D for new tread designs and environmentally sustainable materials.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of tires, supplemented by rental income from real estate assets. The company is also developing additional income streams from royalties, licensing of trademarks, patents, and technology services such as formulation, design, testing, and training.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major domestic competitors include NanKang, HuaFeng, Cheng Shin, Kenda, and Taiwan Bridgestone. The company positions itself by leveraging proprietary tread designs and a broad global distribution network to compete in the mid to high-end tire market segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated net revenue of approximately NT$267 million in the latest fiscal year, a 44% decrease from the prior year, with a net loss of NT$465 million. The company is undergoing operational restructuring, including plant shutdowns and outsourcing, aiming to restore growth and profitability amid challenging global economic conditions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes unique tire tread designs developed independently to enhance performance across various functions. It focuses on producing environmentally friendly, energy-saving tires with extended mileage and reduced environmental impact, aiming to meet increasing global demand for green automotive products.
